youtube_description: Shows how to package and carry your toothpaste, lotions, and sunscreen efficiently while backpacking and camping. Avoids mess and minimizes weight for Thru Hikers and UltraLight Backpackers, or Bow Valley Climbers who often shave their armpits and tooth brush bristles to save weight. Do your friends cast shade and make you feel guilty about abusing single use plastics? Walk the moral high ground and go to the asian mall and get some bubble drink straws from the garbage and re-use them for this. Plan ahead: makes a great economical present for that person that has everything.
